stories.title: Backfill backlog metadata (47 drifted stories) + un-break pm_status
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: enumerate every backlog.json story missing any required field (status, createdAt, updatedAt, conditionalOutcomes, tasks) and classify each by the sprint/version it shipped in (git history / sprint archives) BEFORE backfilling

Backfill the missing fields: status per the story REAL end-state (shipped Sprint 50-55 stories -> complete; any genuinely-open -> its real status), conditionalOutcomes/tasks -> [] where absent, createdAt/updatedAt from backlog.json git history (first-appearance commit) where feasible else the story sprint date (mark proxy-derived)
pm_status.py runs clean (no KeyError) AND sprint_lint --backlog returns 0 errors afterward
reusable idempotent offices/pm/scripts/backfill_story_metadata.py (skips already-compliant stories; re-run = no-op)
metadata-only: do NOT alter semantic content (title/goal/DoD/type/size/parent) of any story
ruff clean in-loop
conditionalOutcomes: if a story real end-state is ambiguous from git/archives -> mark status conservatively + note the proxy; never guess complete for genuinely-open work
stories.goal: As the PM, I want every backlog story to carry its required fields and the tooling (pm_status, --backlog lint) to run clean, so the 47-story metadata drift (Sprints 50-55) is repaired and cannot recur.

stories.title: PM-tooling Windows UTF-8 hardening (stop cp1252 crashes)
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: identify which offices/pm/scripts print or open() unicode (the arrow glyphs and similar non-ASCII) and currently require PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 to avoid crashing
those scripts set UTF-8 internally (guarded sys.stdout/stderr.reconfigure(encoding=utf-8)) AND all open() use encoding=utf-8
create offices/pm/knowledge/feedback-pm-windows-encoding-ad-hoc-audits.md (canonical recipe: PYTHONIOENCODING + encoding=utf-8; reference _freeze.py)
ruff clean in-loop

validationCriteria.action: run each touched PM script on Windows WITHOUT PYTHONIOENCODING set

stories.goal: As any agent on Windows, I want the PM scripts to not crash on cp1252 when printing/reading unicode, so ad-hoc backlog/sprint audits do not die with UnicodeEncodeError.

stories.title: TD-057 stale git index.lock guarded helper (slow-NAS)
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: confirm the failure mode (stale index.lock from the slow SMB share blocking commits) + how to reliably detect a live git process holding the lock
helper retries-with-backoff on lock; clears ONLY if no git process is running AND the lock exceeds an age threshold; NEVER force-deletes under a live process (the discipline invariant)
documented usage; wired where PM commits happen if practical
ruff clean in-loop

validationCriteria.action: simulate a stale lock (no live git process)
validationCriteria.outcome: helper clears it + the commit succeeds

stories.goal: As an agent on the chi-nas-01 share, I want a guarded helper that waits out (and only clears a truly-stale) .git/index.lock, so lock churn stops blocking commits without ever deleting a lock a live git process holds.

stories.title: Formalize Story.md-mirror retirement (backlog.json = SSOT)
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: grep skills/commands/PM-Rules/folder-structure docs for existing Story.md-mirror references before editing
update PM Rule / folder-structure docs: stories live in backlog.json; offices/pm/backlog/US-*.md mirrors are retired/optional (newest mirror ~US-398)
remove or annotate any skill/command step that instructs writing Story.md mirrors

validationCriteria.outcome: only the retirement note remains; no step still requires mirrors

stories.goal: As the PM, I want the dropped Story.md-mirror convention formally retired, so backlog.json is the single story SSOT and no skill/doc implies mirrors are required.

stories.title: SS-T7 deploy-gate tripwire into /sprint-deploy-pm Phase-0
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: locate the best-effort-continue-past-red gap in the current deploy path (the V0.27.17 marker-on-failure class) + define what Phase-0 must assert
Phase-0 asserts pre-flight / marker integrity and HALTS on failure (no best-effort continue past a red gate)

[ATLAS GAP 2026-07-13] Phase-0 RUNS pytest -m "not slow" (the suite CONTAINING the SS-T7 systemd-parity test) and HALTS on non-zero exit -- run-not-trust: NOT a file/marker check, NOT 'we ran it earlier' or 'Ralph reported green'. SS-T7 lesson (V0.27.12 DOA): the tripwire test EXISTED but the pipeline never RAN it
ruff clean in-loop

validationCriteria.action: dry-run /sprint-deploy-pm Phase-0 with a deliberately failing test in the not-slow suite
validationCriteria.outcome: Phase-0 RUNS pytest -m 'not slow', gets non-zero, and HALTS the deploy -- does not check a marker or trust a prior report

stories.goal: As the PM, I want the deploy-gate tripwire welded into /sprint-deploy-pm Phase-0, so a deploy cannot proceed past a failed pre-flight (the best-effort-continue class that let V0.27.17 ship broken).

stories.title: Real-MariaDB migration test CI-enablement (testcontainers/11.x)
acceptance: Pre-flight audit: confirm US-464 live layer currently honest-skips (no Docker on bench) + what CI infra is available (Docker-enabled runner / MariaDB service container)
add testcontainers (or a MariaDB service-container config) to a dev/CI-only requirements set -- NOT a runtime dep (Pi/server prod installs must not pull it)
wire a CI job running pytest tests/server/test_migration_chain_real_mariadb.py -m integration against MariaDB 11.x (matching prod 11.8.6 per Atlas TIGHTEN-2)
the live layer executes + gates in CI (no longer honest-skip there); document the local DSN path (OBD2_MARIADB_TEST_DSN) for manual runs

[ATLAS TIGHTEN 2026-07-13] annotate TD-055; CLOSE it ONLY when the CI test actually EXECUTES + gates (validationCriteria#1 green in CI). If it falls to the DSN-manual interim (Docker unavailable) -> TD-055 stays OPEN-downgraded, NOT closed. Add a pointer from the create_all caveat in tests/integration/test_deploy_context_drive_simulator.py
ruff clean in-loop

validationCriteria.outcome: the live real-MariaDB integration test EXECUTES (not skipped) against 11.x -- passes on clean schema, fails on seeded drift
testcontainers is NOT present in runtime/prod deps

conditionalOutcomes: if the CI environment truly cannot run Docker -> document the concrete blocker + keep the DSN-based manual gate as the interim; do NOT silently mark done
stories.goal: As the maintainer, I want US-464 live real-MariaDB migration test to run in CI (not just on-demand), so the BL-019/020/021 drift class is gated automatically instead of relying on the deploy.
